_readme: Single source of truth for the shop. Values from GVP-PRICE-01 (Researcher, 8 Oct 2026), IDR column, adopted by the team. IDR ONLY: Bank Indonesia bans dual quotation (PBI 17/3/2015 art. 11, SEBI 17/11/DKSP), so no other currency may be shown, stored for display or toggled on public pages. Launch defaults approved by the founder on 8 Oct 2026: prices and cart ON for clients outside Indonesia; clients based in Indonesia are confirmed offline with bilingual engagement terms until the Indonesian terms are published. No standalone digital-product SKUs: digital materials may only appear as included items inside a package. No was-prices, no countdowns. Schema is documented in the conversion-pass-2 brief.

flags._note: indonesiaCheckoutReady stays false until the Indonesian terms (/id/terms/) are reviewed and published. While false, buyers based in Indonesia see the same IDR prices but are asked to book a call or request a quote, and their order is confirmed offline with bilingual engagement terms.

currencies._note: IDR only. English pages show amounts as the invoice states them: "IDR 20 million", "IDR 12.5 million", "IDR 2.4 billion", falling back to "IDR 12,345,678". Bahasa pages show Rp20.000.000. Do not add a second currency.

notes.text: Go ahead with an Implementation Oversight project of IDR 90 million or more within 30 days of receiving your report and the full audit fee is credited against it. You keep the report either way. The credit does not combine with other offers.
Book a full Operations Audit within 30 days and the Focus Audit fee is credited against it. The credit does not apply to projects, retainers or advisory work.

Operations Audit guarantee. Before the audit starts, we agree with you in writing how annual time and cost savings will be estimated. If the savings estimate in your report, using that method, is lower than the audit fee you paid, you can ask for 50% of the audit fee back. Send a written request to connect@grandvisionperspective.com within 14 days of receiving the report. We refund within 14 days of receiving a valid request, in IDR, to the account the payment came from. The guarantee does not apply if you did not provide the access, data or staff time agreed in writing for the audit. One claim per client business. This guarantee is in addition to your rights under the law.
notes.textId: Jaminan Operations Audit. Sebelum audit dimulai, kami menyepakati secara tertulis dengan Anda cara memperkirakan penghematan waktu dan biaya tahunan. Jika perkiraan penghematan dalam laporan Anda, dengan metode tersebut, lebih rendah daripada biaya audit yang Anda bayar, Anda dapat meminta pengembalian 50% dari biaya audit. Kirim permintaan tertulis ke connect@grandvisionperspective.com dalam 14 hari sejak menerima laporan. Kami mengembalikan dana dalam 14 hari sejak menerima permintaan yang sah, dalam Rupiah, ke rekening asal pembayaran. Jaminan ini tidak berlaku jika Anda tidak memberikan akses, data, atau waktu staf yang disepakati secara tertulis untuk audit. Satu klaim per usaha klien. Jaminan ini merupakan tambahan atas hak Anda menurut hukum.

notes.text: Optional retainer, after handover: IDR 45,000,000 a month, billed monthly in advance, 3-month minimum, or IDR 128,250,000 for 3 months paid up front (5% off). It includes up to 12 oversight hours a month across up to 3 covered workflows (the monthly report and a 60-minute review call count towards them); a weekly review of run history using read-only access you grant, with written findings and recommendations; small adjustments made by your staff to our written specification, or by us as assisted configuration with your written authorisation; and response-time targets for advice: P1 within 4 business hours with a written plan within 1 business day, P2 within 1 business day with a plan within 3, P3 within 2 business days. These are targets to respond and advise, not fix times, and no service credits apply. We tell you in writing when 75% of the month's included hours have been used. Extra hours cost IDR 4,500,000 an hour and are used only if you agree them in writing first. Unused hours do not roll over and have no cash value. We do not host, operate or manage your systems or accounts: you and your vendors stay responsible for them.
notes.textId: Retainer opsional, setelah serah terima: Rp45.000.000 per bulan, ditagih di muka setiap bulan, minimum 3 bulan, atau Rp128.250.000 untuk 3 bulan yang dibayar di muka (diskon 5%). Termasuk hingga 12 jam pengawasan per bulan untuk paling banyak 3 alur kerja yang dicakup (laporan bulanan dan panggilan tinjauan 60 menit dihitung di dalamnya); tinjauan mingguan atas riwayat eksekusi menggunakan akses baca-saja yang Anda berikan, disertai temuan dan rekomendasi tertulis; penyesuaian kecil yang dilakukan staf Anda berdasarkan spesifikasi tertulis kami, atau oleh kami sebagai konfigurasi berpendamping dengan otorisasi tertulis Anda; serta target waktu tanggapan untuk saran: P1 dalam 4 jam kerja dengan rencana tertulis dalam 1 hari kerja, P2 dalam 1 hari kerja dengan rencana dalam 3 hari kerja, P3 dalam 2 hari kerja. Ini adalah target untuk menanggapi dan memberi saran, bukan waktu penyelesaian, dan tidak ada kompensasi layanan. Kami memberi tahu Anda secara tertulis saat 75% jam yang termasuk bulan itu telah terpakai. Jam tambahan Rp4.500.000 per jam dan hanya digunakan jika Anda menyetujuinya secara tertulis terlebih dahulu. Jam yang tidak terpakai tidak dapat dialihkan ke bulan berikutnya dan tidak memiliki nilai uang. Kami tidak menghosting, mengoperasikan, atau mengelola sistem atau akun Anda: Anda dan vendor Anda tetap bertanggung jawab atasnya.
